figures.caption: Figure 1. Comparison of training paradigms. Left (ODE): Terminal supervision is well-posed for deterministic ODEs but results in a narrow expert manifold. Middle (Naive SDE): Stochastic rollouts introduce a wider exploration space, but coarse terminal supervision fails to correct deviations, leading to misalignment. Right (π-StepNFT): Our method leverages the wider space from SDE but applies finer, step-wise ranking guidance to ensure robust alignment with the expert manifold.
